definitions.explanation: Sustained effort toward achieving a goal. Emphasizes hard work and perseverance.

examples.japanese: もっと{努力|どりょく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{努力|どりょく}すれば{夢|ゆめ}は{叶|かな}う。
examples.english: If you make an effort, your dreams will come true.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{成功|せいこう}は{努力|どりょく}の{結果|けっか}だ。
examples.english: His success is the result of his efforts.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to keep making an effort every day.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}を{重|かさ}ねて、やっと{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: After sustained effort, I finally passed the exam.

notes:
USAGE: {努力|どりょく} is a highly valued concept in Japanese culture. Hard work and perseverance are seen as essential qualities.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{努力|どりょく}する (to make an effort)
・{努力|どりょく}を{重|かさ}ねる (to make continued efforts)
・{努力|どりょく}の{賜物|たまもの} (the fruit of one's efforts)
・{努力|どりょく}{家|か} (hard worker)
・{努力|どりょく}{目標|もくひょう} (effort targets/goals)
・{不断|ふだん}の{努力|どりょく} (constant effort)

CULTURAL NOTE: Japan values {努力|どりょく} highly. The belief that success comes from effort rather than innate talent is deeply ingrained. This is reflected in expressions like 「{石|いし}の{上|うえ}にも{三|さん}{年|ねん}」(perseverance will win in the end).

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{頑張|がんば}る (to do one's best)
・{苦労|くろう} (hardship, trouble)
・{精進|しょうじん} (devotion, diligence)
